crossRefs.note: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of…
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

translations.web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
translations.bsb: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
translations.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
translations.asv: He that is stedfast in righteousness shall attain unto life; And he that pursueth evil doeth it to his own death.
